title: design: editor timeline v2 — tracks on demand, camera sections, media overlays
body:
Design PR, docs only, no code. Stacked on #437 (webcam track design). No Linear ticket: the workspace is at its free issue limit.

## Summary (one minute)

The editor's timeline today shows every lane all the time, and the camera can only be hidden or overridden in jumps. Timeline v2 does three things:

- **Tracks on demand.** Clips and Audio are always shown. The Camera lane is shown whenever the take recorded a camera. Annotations, Zooms, Privacy and Overlay lanes appear when something goes on them, or through "+ Add track". Removing a lane hides its edits and leaves them out of the export until the lane is added back. Activity becomes marks inside Zooms, and a fresh recording lists its zooms as suggestions.
- **Camera sections.** A section moves and resizes the camera from a point in the video. Its transition lives inside the section, at its start: Slide or Cut, with a duration per section and CSS-style easing (presets plus a custom cubic-bezier). Hiding and showing fade over 200 ms. One pure function of source time drives the preview, the MP4 and the GIF.
- **Media overlays.** A Library clip, a Finder file or an image goes on an Overlay lane, drawn after the zoom crop. Lanes stack, and the upper one covers the lower. Each overlay video brings its own audio lane that mutes on its own, and the export mixes them.

A generic "anything on any track" timeline is rejected. Background music and camera-only clips go to the backlog.

## Decisions

| # | Decision | ADR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Five phases: (A) camera sections, (B) tracks on demand, (C) image overlays, (D) video overlays with per-source audio and mixing, (E) music, backlog only | — |
| 2 | A section changes only position and size; shape, mirror, shadow, shrink-during-zoom and framing stay global | 0039 (new) |
| 3 | The transition belongs to the section and plays inside it at its start. Default Slide, 400 ms, ease-in-out. Duration capped at 50 % of the section. Chains start from the previous target. | 0039 |
| 4 | CSS easing model: four presets plus a custom cubic-bezier, one stateless solver | 0039 |
| 5 | Hide and show fade over 200 ms **outside** the hidden range, so nothing that was hidden is ever shown | 0039 |
| 6 | Gestures: Move from here, drag inside or outside a section, ⇧-drag for the global layout, Split, Remove section | reuses 0039 |
| 7 | The Camera lane always shows when the take has a camera, and it cannot be removed | reuses 0040 |
| 8 | Typed tracks on demand. A removed track's edits are hidden and not exported. Removing Privacy asks first. | 0040 (new) |
| 9 | Activity becomes marks inside Zooms; zooms start as suggestions | 0040 |
| 10 | Stackable media lanes, unlimited, upper covers lower. In code they are "media"; the UI says "Overlay". | 0040 |
| 11 | Media items are anchored to timeline time | 0040 |
| 12 | Sources come only through the compose design's import and drag path. The drop target is the lane. | reuses 0018 (#279) |
| 13 | Placement in the output frame. Order: frame → redactions → annotations → zoom crop → framing → media → camera | reuses 0033, 0040 |
| 14 | Audio stays per source: one audio lane per media lane, with per-lane and per-item mutes | 0040 |
| 15 | The export mixes: resample to 48 kHz, sum, soft clip | 0040 |
| 16 | Preview: one `<video>` per visible video item, with the webcam's drift rule; at most 2 visible at once | 0040 |
| 17 | Export: one input per item for the length of its span, read by range; frames filled while anything animates | reuses #279 spike, 0040 |
| 18 | The session stays version 1; every new field is additive | reuses 0033 |
| 19 | Export reuse: `wc1 → wc2` for edit and whole fingerprints; `md1` with media | reuses 0033 |
| 20 | Music and camera-only clips: backlog pages only | — |

The full table, with the reason for each decision, is in the spec.

## What it extends or reopens

- **ADR 0033**: [ADR 0039](apps/documentation/src/content/docs/architecture/decisions/0039-camera-sections-with-eased-transitions.mdx) amends its decision 2 and lifts its non-goal "animated layout transitions". 0033's Status line and its index row note the amendment. The body is not edited.
- **Webcam spec, "Out of scope"**: animated transitions and camera-only scenes are reopened, because the owner explicitly asked on 2026-10-31. The bullet carries a note.
- **Compose spec (#279, another open branch, not edited here)**: this reopens its out-of-scope line "picture-in-picture" and adds one target to its decision 5. That PR should take the note.

## ADR numbering

Taken: **0039** and **0040**. `main` already holds 0032–0034, from the workspaces design #431. Four open ADRs collide with them and will need new numbers when they rebase: this base's 0032 and 0033 (#437), 0032 "file name follows the title" (#435) and 0033 "library reconciles" (#460). 0035–0038 are left free for those. If #437 renumbers 0033, the links to it in these files need the same rename.

## Open questions (defaulted)

1. Zoom suggestions are no longer applied on open. This reverses the shipped v2 default, and it is the one most worth the owner's eye.
2. Returning to the global layout after a section uses that section's own transition.
3. At most 2 visible video overlays: to be measured on hardware at the start of phase D.
4. Overlays enter and leave with a cut.
5. Timeline anchoring for overlays, versus Final Cut-style connected clips.
6. Privacy regions do not blur overlays.
7. "Bounce" is a single overshoot (`back`).
8. A removed overlay lane is hidden, not deleted.
9. Phases C and D depend on #279's import, drag and range spike.

## How to review it yourself

1. `apps/documentation/src/content/docs/specs/2026-10-31-editor-timeline-v2-design.md`. Read the one-minute block first: the summary, the table, open questions, out of scope, failures and acceptance criteria. Then read § 2 (the camera state function) and § 4 (media lanes).
2. `apps/documentation/src/content/docs/architecture/decisions/0039-camera-sections-with-eased-transitions.mdx`
3. `apps/documentation/src/content/docs/architecture/decisions/0040-typed-tracks-on-demand-and-stackable-media-lanes.mdx`. Check that the rejected "generic timeline" alternative is argued the way you want it.
4. The small edits: the Status line of ADR 0033, the out-of-scope note in `specs/2026-10-30-webcam-track-design.md`, the `backlog/webcam-track.md` follow-ups line, and the rows in `architecture/decisions/index.mdx` and `backlog/index.mdx`.
5. `backlog/background-music.md` and `backlog/camera-only-clips.md`.
6. Optional: run `bun run dev` in `apps/documentation`, open `/specs/2026-10-31-editor-timeline-v2-design/`, and check that the tables render and the sidebar lists both backlog pages.

Checks run: `astro build` of the docs site passed (353 pages, no broken internal links in the new pages), and `oxfmt` ran on every touched file. Nothing in Electron was run.
